items.author: kathmachine.bsky.social
items.context: I love this, and I've always loved the specific Kid Energy of using whatever is available to you for games and game design? honestly a goal to try to reconnect with some of the spark that made me draw maze dungeons on my dad's office paper and try to make games in like ms-dos spreadsheet programs
items.text: Maze dungeons on office paper is a great memory. Fun detail: the classic DOS games on GOG come with DOSBox already set up, so they just run on a modern PC.

i remember sitting among the empty cubicles at my dad's office on the weekend, typing "game instruction manuals" into DOS word processing programs with ASCII-art illustrations and printing them on the loud-ass dot matrix printers
quotes @jeannethornton.bsky.social: One of my favorite tiny Jeanne memories: going in with my dad to his office when he had to work Saturdays, making maze games in the MS dos …
items.text: ASCII-art manuals on a dot matrix printer sounds like the best kind of weekend. That printer noise is unforgettable.
